specifications.name: Model Context Protocol
specifications.description: A client–server protocol for connecting AI applications to tools, resources, prompts, and external context.
specifications.standardizes: Capability negotiation, lifecycle, JSON-RPC messages, tools, resources, prompts, sampling, and related client–server features.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Agent-to-agent task delegation, an agent runtime, or how applications rank and use retrieved context.
specifications.license_note: The repository documents a transition: the current specification and new contributions use Apache-2.0, earlier contributions retain MIT, and non-specification documentation uses CC BY 4.0.

license_evidence.scope: Current specification and new repository contributions
Contributions predating the documented license transition
Repository documentation outside the normative specification

specifications.name: Agent2Agent Protocol
specifications.description: An interoperability protocol for discovering independent agents, delegating tasks, and exchanging messages and artifacts.
specifications.standardizes: Agent cards, task lifecycle, messages, artifacts, streaming, push notifications, and authenticated agent-to-agent interaction.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Tool access inside an agent, the agent's internal planner, or front-end event rendering.
specifications.license_note: The specification repository is licensed under Apache-2.0.

specifications.name: Agent–User Interaction Protocol
specifications.description: An event-based protocol for connecting agent runtimes to user-facing applications and interactive front ends.
specifications.standardizes: Streaming events for messages, tools, state, lifecycle, and human-in-the-loop interaction between agents and applications.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Agent-to-agent delegation, model-to-tool discovery, or a specific component library and visual design.
specifications.license_note: The reference repository is licensed under MIT.

specifications.name: Agent Client Protocol
specifications.description: A protocol for connecting coding agents to editors, IDEs, and other interactive clients.
specifications.standardizes: Session setup, prompts, streamed updates, tool calls, permissions, files, terminals, and client–agent capabilities.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Agent-to-agent coordination, general model tool discovery, or repository instruction-file semantics.
specifications.license_note: The protocol repository is licensed under Apache-2.0.

specifications.name: AGENTS.md
specifications.description: An open Markdown convention for giving coding agents persistent, repository-scoped instructions.
specifications.standardizes: A discoverable filename and hierarchical placement pattern for human-authored project guidance consumed by compatible agents.
specifications.does_not_standardize: A front-matter schema, an agent wire protocol, tool permissions, or a universal instruction vocabulary.
specifications.license_note: The reference repository and site source are licensed under MIT.

specifications.name: CLAUDE.md
specifications.description: Claude Code's documented Markdown convention for persistent project and user instructions.
specifications.standardizes: Where Claude Code discovers project memory, user instructions, imports, and directory-scoped guidance inside its own product ecosystem.
specifications.does_not_standardize: A vendor-neutral repository instruction format, a wire protocol, or behavior in agents that do not implement Claude Code's convention.
specifications.license_note: The product documentation defines the convention, but no standalone reusable format license was identified during review.

license_evidence.scope: CLAUDE.md convention as described in product documentation; no standalone format license identified

specifications.name: GitHub Copilot repository instructions
specifications.description: GitHub Copilot's documented convention for persistent repository-wide and path-specific instructions.
specifications.standardizes: Discovery of .github/copilot-instructions.md and recursive .github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md files, per-surface support for applyTo glob front matter, GitHub.com excludeAgent controls, and documented instruction combination behavior inside Copilot.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Vendor-neutral instruction semantics, AGENTS.md itself, agent execution, permissions, or a wire protocol.
specifications.license_note: The reviewed GitHub Docs content is licensed under CC BY 4.0; Copilot as a service remains governed separately.

license_evidence.scope: GitHub Docs content defining the instruction convention

specifications.name: GEMINI.md
specifications.description: Gemini CLI's documented convention for persistent user, workspace, and component-level instructional context.
specifications.standardizes: GEMINI.md discovery, global and workspace hierarchy, just-in-time directory loading, concatenation, @ imports, memory commands, and configurable context filenames inside Gemini CLI.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Vendor-neutral precedence, model memory storage, permissions, a wire protocol, or behavior in other agents.
specifications.license_note: The Gemini CLI repository and reviewed documentation are licensed under Apache-2.0; Gemini service terms remain separate.

specifications.name: Cline Rules
specifications.description: Cline's product convention for persistent workspace and global agent guidance.
specifications.standardizes: Discovery and aggregation of Markdown or text rules under .clinerules/, workspace and global precedence, rule toggles, and optional path-conditional YAML front matter; Cline CLI documents .cline/rules/ separately.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Vendor-neutral instruction semantics, execution permissions, a tool protocol, or a universal instruction vocabulary.
specifications.license_note: The Cline repository and reviewed documentation are licensed under Apache-2.0.

specifications.name: Cursor Project Rules
specifications.description: Cursor's documented convention for persistent and context-sensitive project instructions.
specifications.standardizes: .cursor/rules/*.mdc placement, activation front matter, four activation modes, nested rule discovery, and file or rule references inside Cursor.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Cross-agent instruction behavior, agent or tool protocols, permission policy, or a universal content vocabulary; the older .cursorrules file is deprecated.
specifications.license_note: No standalone reusable-format license was identified in the reviewed product documentation; Cursor's service and documentation terms apply separately.

license_evidence.scope: Cursor project-rules convention; no standalone reusable-format license identified

specifications.name: Continue Rules
specifications.description: Continue's product convention for project-local Markdown and YAML instructions used across its interaction modes.
specifications.standardizes: Rule discovery under .continue/rules/, lexicographic loading, and front-matter controls for names, globs, regular expressions, descriptions, and unconditional activation.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Universal agent instructions, permission or tool execution, a wire protocol, or other products' interpretation.
specifications.license_note: The Continue repository and reviewed documentation are licensed under Apache-2.0.

specifications.name: Roo Code Rules
specifications.description: Roo Code's convention for global, workspace, and mode-specific persistent instructions.
specifications.standardizes: Discovery under .roo/rules/ and mode-specific directories, recursive alphabetical aggregation and precedence, plus fallback .roorules files inside Roo Code.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Cross-agent interpretation, mode definitions, permissions, or machine-to-machine protocols.
specifications.license_note: The Roo Code documentation subtree reviewed for this convention is licensed under Apache-2.0.

specifications.name: Devin Desktop Rules
specifications.description: Devin Desktop's current convention for persistent Cascade instructions, including legacy Windsurf compatibility paths.
specifications.standardizes: Rule discovery across workspace and parent directories, trigger-based activation, current .devin/rules/*.md placement, and fallback .windsurf/rules/*.md or .windsurfrules paths.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Instruction behavior in other agents, workflows or skills, permissions, or wire protocols.
specifications.license_note: No standalone reusable-format license was identified in the reviewed product documentation; the legacy Windsurf names describe compatibility paths, not a separate current convention.

specifications.name: Agent Skills
specifications.description: An open folder format for packaging reusable agent instructions, metadata, scripts, and supporting resources.
specifications.standardizes: A SKILL.md manifest, required metadata, optional resources, discovery, and progressive loading of capability instructions.
specifications.does_not_standardize: A marketplace, runtime permission model, inter-agent messaging, or the quality and safety of bundled scripts.
specifications.license_note: Repository code is Apache-2.0; the specification documentation is licensed under CC BY 4.0.

license_evidence.scope: Repository code outside the documentation-specific license

specifications.name: Agent Plugins
specifications.description: An open package format for distributing agent skills and MCP server configuration as one portable, client-neutral plugin.
specifications.standardizes: The plugin.json manifest, plugin root containment, fixed discovery locations for skills and MCP servers, namespaced client extensions, placeholder expansion, and client conformance requirements.
specifications.does_not_standardize: A marketplace, runtime sandbox, universal permission system, inter-agent communication, or portable commands, agents, and hooks, which version 1 leaves to namespaced client extensions.
specifications.license_note: Schemas and code samples are Apache-2.0; the specification and documentation are CC BY 4.0.

specifications.name: Claude Code Plugins
specifications.description: Claude Code's documented plugin package and marketplace convention for installing skills, agents, hooks, and servers as one bundle.
specifications.standardizes: The optional .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest and its component path fields, default locations for skills, commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers, LSP servers, and experimental themes and monitors, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA path expansion, installation scopes, and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json catalog entries and plugin sources.
specifications.does_not_standardize: A portable contract other clients implement, the SKILL.md format itself, MCP wire behavior, a runtime sandbox or permission model, or plugin behavior in agents that do not implement Claude Code's loader.
specifications.license_note: Product documentation defines the convention and no standalone reusable format license was identified during review; the steward's own plugin repository content, including the reviewed marketplace manifest, is reserved under Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service.

specifications.name: WebMCP
specifications.description: A browser API that lets web applications expose structured JavaScript and form-based tools to AI agents.
specifications.standardizes: Registration, discovery, description, schema, invocation, cancellation, and lifecycle behavior for tools exposed by a web document to browser or embedded agents.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Remote MCP transports, an agent runtime, generic browser automation, or the application-specific semantics and authorization policy behind each web tool.
specifications.license_note: Reports in the repository use the W3C Software and Document License; the draft is a Community Group Report, not a W3C Standard or Standards Track document.

specifications.name: Open Agentic Schema Framework
specifications.description: A versioned schema and taxonomy for describing agent records, capabilities, domains, modules, and locators.
specifications.standardizes: Agent-record metadata, skill and domain taxonomies, extensible modules, locators, versioning, and validation used to announce and discover agent capabilities.
specifications.does_not_standardize: A discovery network or registry transport, cryptographic identity proof, agent-to-agent task lifecycle, authentication, or an agent runtime.
specifications.license_note: The schema, server, and documentation repository are licensed under Apache-2.0.

specifications.name: Agent Network Protocol
specifications.description: An open protocol stack for decentralized agent identity, service discovery, secure messaging, and cross-domain communication.
specifications.standardizes: DID-based agent and group identity, endpoint and capability discovery, message bindings, direct and group messaging profiles, attachments, proofs, and optional encryption overlays.
specifications.does_not_standardize: An agent's internal planner or tools, a universal runtime, implementation-specific replica state, or every domain-specific application protocol.
specifications.license_note: The specification repository is licensed under Apache-2.0.

specifications.name: Agent Payments Protocol
specifications.description: A payment-security protocol for proving a user's authorization and preserving evidence when an agent performs a transaction.
specifications.standardizes: Participant roles, checkout and payment mandates, receipts, human-present and autonomous authorization modes, verification responsibilities, and dispute evidence.
specifications.does_not_standardize: Catalog, cart, or checkout APIs; transport; the underlying payment rail; merchant fulfillment; or an agent's planning behavior.
specifications.license_note: The specification, SDK, and samples repository is licensed under Apache-2.0.

specifications.name: Universal Commerce Protocol
specifications.description: A commerce protocol for capability discovery and interoperable shopping flows across agents, applications, businesses, and payment providers.
specifications.standardizes: Business and platform profiles, capability negotiation, checkout, orders, identity linking, and payment-token exchange across supported commerce transports.
specifications.does_not_standardize: The user's cryptographic authorization mandate, product recommendation ranking, an agent runtime, merchant-specific business logic, or underlying payment settlement.
specifications.license_note: The specification and documentation repository is licensed under Apache-2.0.

specifications.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol
specifications.description: An open interaction model for buyers, agents, sellers, and payment providers to complete programmatic purchases.
specifications.standardizes: Checkout-session APIs, capability negotiation, carts and item feeds, orders, authentication metadata, payment handlers, credential delegation, schemas, examples, and webhooks.
specifications.does_not_standardize: General agent-to-agent messaging, product discovery ranking, a universal payment-authorization mandate, underlying payment rails, or merchant fulfillment operations.
specifications.license_note: The RFC, OpenAPI, JSON Schema, examples, and documentation repository is licensed under Apache-2.0.
